relevance_note: Case series of two related Danon disease patients with individual detail, one with a stated LAMP2 variant: "a heterozygous nonsense mutation in the LAMP2 gene (LAMP2: p.Gln240Ter het) was identified".
method_note: Hand extraction; a Python script in scratch only assembled the JSON and checked spans. Two individuals: Patient 1 (father, deceased) and Patient 2 (daughter). Only Patient 2 is stated to have been genotyped; the paper never says Patient 1 was tested or carries the variant, so Patient 1 has no variant row, and Patient 2's inheritance is 'not reported' (paternal inheritance is not stated). Patient 1 is in scope as described 'affected by Danon disease'. n_patients_reported=2 counts both patients the authors describe as affected, although only one has a stated LAMP2 variant. 'Three generations involving five family members were assessed, but no relevant mutations were detected in other family members' is a group count without individual detail; no rows were created for these relatives, and it was not used as a parental testing statement because parents are not named. Patient 1 cause of death is given three ways (sudden cardiac death; 'Died due to sudden cardiac arrest' in the timeline; 'heart failure in the context of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy' in Patient 2's section): recorded with all three spans. Ages at admission (Patient 1: 31 years; Patient 2: 19 years) are presentation ages, not last evaluation; Patient 2's last follow-up (September 2021) gives no age, so last evaluation is 'not reported'. Patient 2's age at diagnosis (19 years) combines the admission sentence (February 2019, age 19) with the timeline row 'February 2019 | ... mutation detected'. Patient 1's onset of symptoms is not given as an age ('Suspected hypertrophic cardiomyopathy' in 1993 has no age). Group statements naming both patients ('Both patients ... exhibited hypertrophic cardiomyopathy'; 'No skeletal muscle weakness ... in either of the present cases') were applied to each; exclusions from the latter are marked 'inferred from group statement'. The 'other clinical abnormalities' part of that sentence was not used to exclude any specific feature. Patient 1 non-compaction is hedged in the case text ('signs suggestive of') but stated for both patients in the Discussion. Patient 2: elevated creatine kinase-myocardial isoenzyme recorded separately from total creatine kinase, which was normal (checklist 'elevated creatine kinase' excluded). 'The structure, function, and strain of the right ventricle were normal' was recorded as written and not used to exclude right ventricular hypertrophy in the checklist. 'Coronary computed tomography angiography was normal' recorded as an excluded abnormal investigation, nothing more specific. 'she appeared well developed' was not used to exclude developmental delay. Normal echocardiography and ECG 10 years prior were not recorded as features. No tables with stacked cells. The supplementary data is not included in the file (title only).
